title: Golden test vectors and loss report for Arabic ↔ Latin scheme
context: Arabic golden vectors must cover both the vocalized mode (all diacritics present — round-trip provable) and the unvocalized mode (round-trip not claimed — loss report enumerates what is dropped). Hard cases include sun/moon letter assimilation, hamza/madda forms, ta marbuta in construct vs. final position, shadda gemination, and Arabic-Indic digits. All examples are neutral/PD text from open authoritative sources; no personal names.
objective: Create at least 50 golden test vector pairs for the Arabic ↔ Latin (arab-latn-iso233) scheme from open/PD authoritative examples, covering both vocalized and unvocalized input, plus a loss report enumerating what is dropped for unvocalized text. Store in data/vectors/arab-latn-iso233/ and data/loss-reports/arab-latn-iso233.md.
acceptanceCriteria: data/vectors/arab-latn-iso233/ contains >= 50 test vector pairs: >= 25 fully-vocalized (harakat present) for round-trip assertion, and >= 25 unvocalized (for loss-report documentation only, not round-trip assertion)
Hard cases explicitly covered: sun/moon letter assimilation, hamza on alif/waw/ya/standalone, madda, ta marbuta (construct vs. final), shadda, Arabic-Indic digits (٠١٢٣), punctuation passthrough
Each vector records its provenance source (open/PD, from allow-list) and is neutral/PD text — no personal names or politically sensitive geographic names

data/loss-reports/arab-latn-iso233.md enumerates exactly what is dropped or unrecoverable in unvocalized mode (e.g., short vowels [fatha/kasra/damma], shadda context ambiguities); accurate and readable
Vocalized vectors pass the harness round-trip assertion in CI; unvocalized vectors trigger the loss-report smoke check only
Qualified Arabic reviewer confirms vector accuracy and loss report completeness
resources: PLAN.md — hard-case test inventory (Arabic items in Appendix A)
UNGEGN sample word lists for Arabic geographical names
output: data/vectors/arab-latn-iso233/ directory with >= 50 vector entries (>= 25 vocalized, >= 25 unvocalized); data/loss-reports/arab-latn-iso233.md
